thread:
Maya L: idea for next webinar format: "Behind the Scenes: Scaling Inference" but structured as a 30-minute fast-track + 15-minute workshop. keep it practical — attendees should leave with an actual checklist. :spiral_notepad:
Ethan K: sounds good. proposing 45m total: 5m intros, 20m core talk (architecture + tradeoffs), 10m mini-workshop (routing/config exercise), 10m live Q&A.
Priya S: love the checklist outcome. suggest we include a short customer story (2 slides) inside the core talk to ground it. also we should collect 3 onboarding prompts from attendees during registration for live troubleshooting.
Noah D: tentative speakers: me (runtime engineering), Lena (product), and our customer from AtlasRetail. Lena can run the workshop exercise.
Maya L: workshop exercise idea: give a tiny prompt set and ask attendees to pick routing policies (latency-priority, cost-priority, hybrid). we show expected token costs and latency impact. keeps it interactive.
Ethan K: run-of-show draft:
```
00:00-05:00 Host intro + agenda
05:00-25:00 Core talk: real patterns for reliable inference (runtime, routing, caching) + customer vignette
25:00-35:00 Interactive workshop: routing choices (poll + reveal)
35:00-45:00 Live Q&A + resources CTA (checklist + repo)
```
Priya S: promo plan: 3 emails (announce, reminder, final), LinkedIn posts + dev community threads. ask Lena & Noah for 2 bullet takeaways each and a 30s speaker blurb for social.
Maya L: backup plan: pre-record the workshop walkthrough. if interactive tooling fails, we run the poll and then show a short recorded demo of the expected outcomes. checklist: record walkthrough, host cheat sheet, poll backup screenshot, alt video link.
deploy-bot: Reminder: schedule rehearsal slots and add host + speakers. set reminders 48h and 30m before.
Ethan K: rehearsal cadence: full dry-run 48h prior (45m), tech check 1h prior (15m). I want a 10m timebox for the workshop setup during tech check.
Priya S: CTA landing page items: title options (vote): ["Inference in Production: Patterns that Scale", "Ship Faster with Predictable Inference", "Behind the Scenes: Real LLM Serving"] I'll run A/B on the hero stat.
Maya L: metrics to surface live: p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, error rate. keep the dashboard simple and annotate what each means for product teams.
Noah D: slides ask: 8 slides max total. core talk 5 slides, workshop 2 slides, 1 customer slide. plus 30s speaker recordings for promos.
Ethan K: outreach: Priya to draft copy + landing (due Thu), Maya to coordinate customer assets (due Thu), Noah to prepare runtime slides + pre-recorded clips (due Fri).
Priya S: noted. promo cadence: -3 weeks announce, -2 weeks deep dive thread with a mini benchmark stat, -1 week reminder, day-of teaser. target CPA via community + LinkedIn: <$55.
Maya L: agreed. final question: do we gate the workshop materials behind registration? i think yes 1 registers signal intent and gives us prompts for the workshop.
Priya S: gate materials + offer a small follow-up workbook after the event. also include a short survey for workshop choices to feed product insights.
Noah D: all good. I'll upload pre-recorded clips to shared drive and link in the runbook.
Maya L: action items recap: Priya - landing + copy + emails, Ethan - runbook & dashboard config, Noah - slides + pre-record, Maya - calendar + host script. deadlines by Friday EOD. :thumbsup:
Priya S: thanks team 1 I'll post the headline options in the doc for a quick vote and start draft copy.
Maya L: thread closed 1 we'll reconvene after deliverables are in. thanks everyone!
